content.text: ▪︎MC joint disorder; cartilage loss + bone remodeling → deformity, muscle weakness, pain
▪︎also: shoulders, CMC + 1st MTP joints, feet; more likely unilat (RA tends to be bilat)
: obesity, trauma, heavy labor, ⇡ age, family hx
▪︎typically older pts; no significant sex predominance (RA: ♀︎ 30–50yo)
(usage related); aggravated by activity, relieved by rest
▪︎joints cold (RA: soft, warm, tender); joint line tenderness, bony swelling, joint deformity/instability, effusion
▪︎hip OA: anteromedial thigh + groin pain (deep anterior groin, upper thigh, buttocks; may radiate to knee); typically unilateral; aching, stiffness, restricted movement
: NO inflam markers (ie, norm ESR, CRP, ANA, RF, anti-CCP)
joint narrowing, marginal osteophytes, subchondral bone sclerosis, bone cysts
Mod exercise, use of assistive devices PRN); low-impact exercise/PT, orthotics, braces
▪︎acetaminophen: no longer 1st-line for knee + hip OA (studies failed to show clinically significant pain improvement); AAOS 2021 knee OA guideline = outlier still supporting it
▪︎1st-line pharm: oral or topical NSAIDs (eg naproxen)
▪︎Duloxetine: multi joint involvement or NSAIDs CI (2nd-line)
▪︎topical capsaicin (may cause local burning or irritate)
▪︎hyaluronic acid injections: only small superiority over placebo
▪︎compromised funct ⇢ joint replace (partial or total) when conservative mgnt fails
in response to infect or inflam in another part of body
may be seen 1-4wks after Chlamydia or GI infect
= species most classically linked to reactive arthritis
▪︎MC in young, sexually active men; HLA-B27 ⊕ in 50–80%; most cases w/in 4wks of infect
▪︎HLA-B27 dz (PAIR): Psoriatic arthritis, Ankylosing spondylitis, IBD, Reactive arthritis
▪︎unilat/asymmetric, sterile oligoarthritis of LE; knee & ankle MC
▪︎also enthesitis, dactylitis, back pain; bilat injected conjunctiva; oral lesions
▪︎can't see (conjunctivitis, uveitis), can't pee (urethritis), can't climb a tree (arthritis)
▪︎⇡ CRP/ESR; imaging c/w enthesitis or arthritis
▪︎dx = clin: MSK findings + evidence of preceding infect + ⍉other likely dx; may see ⊕stool cultures or Chlamydia NAAT
▪︎ABX may be indicated to tx underlying cause
▪︎NSAID-refractory pain w/ few joints → intra-articular glucocorticoids; many joints → systemic glucocorticoids
▪︎DMARDs reserved for ⍉response to NSAIDs/glucocorticoids; supportive tx for N/V
: chronic systemic autoimmune inflam dz w/ symmetric polyarthritis, bone erosion, cartilage destruction, & joint struct loss
: hyperplastic synovial tissue (pannus) → joint destruction (T cell mediated)
▪︎Felty syndrome: severe/long-standing RA + splenomegaly + neutropenia, anemia, thrombocytopenia
▪︎comp: atlantoaxial (C1-C2) subluxation → myelopathy; septic arthritis; anemia of chronic dz; CAD, osteoporosis
joint pain worse in the Am
, improves throughout day; lasting >6wks; worse after inactivity, alleviated by mild activity
▪︎MC affects sm joints (ie, wrist, MCP, PIP, MTP, ankle)
▪︎also: knees; commonly presents w/ symmetric synovitis of sm joints of hands + feet
▪︎ulnar deviation of hand, rheumatoid nodules (SC, over extensor surfaces)
▪︎extra-articular: xerostomia, xerophthalmia/keratoconjunctivitis sicca, scleritis, peripheral ulcerative keratitis, ILD, pleuritis, organizing pneumonia, pericarditis, vasculitis
joint narrowing, osteopenia, bone & joint erosions
▪︎may be nl w/in 1st 6mo of sx; later soft tissue swelling, juxta-articular osteoporosis, joint space narrowing, joint erosions
▪︎other: sulfasalazine, leflunomide, antimalarials (eg hydroxychloroquine), JAK-i, TNF-i (eg etanercept, infliximab, adalimumab), abatacept, rituximab
